description: This source file defines the SQLProcessor class, which provides utility functions for executing SQL statements, managing database connections, and processing query results within the Apache OFBiz framework.

classes.name: SQLProcessor
classes.description: A utility class providing methods to facilitate database operations such as executing queries and updates, managing transactions, handling resources, and setting query parameters within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: getDelegator
methods.description: Returns the associated Delegator object used for entity operations.

methods.name: getResultSetMetaData
methods.description: Retrieves metadata about the current ResultSet, if available.

methods.name: commit
methods.description: Commits the current transaction if in manual transaction mode.

methods.name: rollback
methods.description: Rolls back the current transaction if in manual transaction mode or marks the transaction for rollback.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes all open resources, including ResultSet, PreparedStatement, and optionally the Connection, committing if in manual mode.

methods.name: getConnection
methods.description: Establishes and returns a database connection, setting auto-commit mode and transaction status appropriately.

methods.name: prepareStatement
methods.description: Prepares a SQL statement, optionally specifying result set type and concurrency.

methods.name: executeQuery
methods.description: Executes the prepared query and returns the ResultSet.

methods.name: executeQuery
methods.description: Prepares and executes a query given an SQL string.

methods.name: executeUpdate
methods.description: Executes an update statement and returns the number of affected rows.

methods.name: executeUpdate
methods.description: Executes a given SQL update string.

methods.name: next
methods.description: Moves the cursor to the next row in the ResultSet.

methods.name: execQuery
methods.description: Executes a query and processes each row with a callback function.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Sets the value of the next parameter in the prepared statement with various data types.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Sets a String parameter in the prepared statement.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Sets a Timestamp parameter.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Sets a Time parameter.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Sets a Date parameter.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Sets an Integer parameter.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Sets a Long parameter.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Sets a Float parameter.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Sets a Double parameter.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Sets a BigDecimal parameter.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Sets a Boolean parameter.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Sets an Object parameter.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Sets a Blob parameter.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Sets a Clob parameter.

methods.name: setBinaryStream
methods.description: Writes serialized data or objects as binary streams into the PreparedStatement.

methods.name: setBytes
methods.description: Sets byte array data as a parameter.

methods.name: testConnection
methods.description: Tests if the provided connection is already used or invalid based on connection testing logic.

methods.name: setFetchSize
methods.description: Configures the fetch size for a statement, considering data source defaults.

methods.name: checkLockWaitInfo
methods.description: Checks exception messages for lock wait timeouts and logs detailed info.

methods.name: executeBatch
methods.description: Executes all batched statements and returns the total affected rows.

methods.name: addBatch
methods.description: Adds the current set of parameters as a batch to the PreparedStatement.
